'''João Nuno Calado Pimenta Lopes''' (born 12 April 1980) is a Portuguese politician who served as a [[member of the European Parliament]], representing [[Portugal (European Parliament constituency)|Portugal]] for the [[Portuguese Communist Party]], from 2016 to 2024. He was appointed to replace [[Inês Zuber]] following her resignation.

== Career ==
He was elected as MEP in the [[2019 European Parliament election in Portugal|2019 European Parliament election]]. In the European Parliament, he was a member of the far-left political group [[The Left in the European Parliament|The Left – GUE/NGL]].

=== Political positions ===
During his tenure, he has taken political positions marked by a consistently [[Russophilia|pro-Russia]] stance. Analyses of his voting record have identified him among the MEPs closest aligned with Russian state interests, opposing all resolutions critical of the Russian government.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2024-06-06|title=Revealed: Russia’s best friends in the EU Parliament|url=https://www.politico.eu/article/revealed-russias-best-friends-eu-parliament/|access-date=2026-01-23|website=POLITICO|language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Dois eurodeputados portugueses entre os "maiores amigos de Putin" no Parlamento Europeu |url=https://cnnportugal.iol.pt/europa-24/eurodeputados/dois-eurodeputados-portugueses-entre-os-maiores-amigos-de-putin-no-parlamento-europeu/20240606/6661e271d34ebf9bbb3e5c7d |access-date=2026-01-23 |website=CNN Portugal |language=pt}}</ref>

On 2 March 2022, he was one of 13 MEPs who voted against condemning the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]] and against designating Russia as a state sponsor of terrorism in the context of deliberate [[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian attacks on Ukrainian civilians]] and [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure|civilian infrastructure]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-02 |title=We asked 13 MEPs why they voted no to condemn Russia's war in Ukraine |url=http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2022/03/02/meps-were-asked-to-condemn-russia-s-invasion-of-ukraine-13-voted-no-here-s-why |access-date=2026-01-23 |website=euronews |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Which EU politicians refused to label Russia a sponsor of terror? |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/25/russia-labelled-as-sponsors-of-terrorism-how-did-europe-vote |access-date=2026-01-10 |website=Al Jazeera |language=en}}</ref>

On 15 September 2022, he was one of 16 MEPs who voted against condemning President [[Daniel Ortega]] of [[Nicaragua]] for human rights violations, in particular the arrest of Bishop [[Rolando José Álvarez Lagos|Rolando Álvarez]]. <ref>{{cite web|title=European Parliament condemns growing repression of Catholic Church in Nicaragua, calls for release of bishop|url=https://www.ewtnnews.com/world/europe/european-parliament-condemns-growing-repression-of-catholic-church-in-nicaragua-calls-for-release-of-bishop}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Nicaragua, in particular the arrest of the bishop Rolando Álvarez|url= https://www.europarl.europa.eu/doceo/document/PV-9-2022-09-15-RCV_FR.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Dispatch |first=Peoples |title=Communist MEP defends small scale fishing industry in European Parliament |url=https://peoplesdispatch.org/2023/01/25/communist-mep-defends-small-scale-fishing-industry-in-european-parliament/ |access-date=2023-01-25 |website=peoplesdispatch}}</ref>

In 2023, he was among 14 MEPs who voted against a resolution condemning the abduction of [[Tibet|Tibetan]] children and other [[Sinicization#Tibet|forced assimilation practices]] carried out by China.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Vote results: The abduction of Tibetan children and forced assimilation practices through Chinese boarding schools in Tibet|url=https://howtheyvote.eu/votes/162922|website=HowTheyVote.eu|date=2023-12-14|access-date=2026-01-23|language=en}}</ref>

In 2024, he voted against a resolution recognizing the [[Holodomor]] as a genocide.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Vote results: 90 years after the Holodomor: recognising the mass killing through starvation as genocide|url=https://howtheyvote.eu/votes/151387|website=HowTheyVote.eu|date=2022-12-15|access-date=2026-01-23|language=en}}</ref>

==Parliamentary service==
* Vice-Chair, [[Committee on Women's Rights and Gender Equality]] (2016-)
* Member, Delegation to the Euro-Latin American Parliamentary Assembly
* Member, Committee on Employment and Social Affairs
* Member, Delegation for relations with the Federative Republic of Brazil
